   206	    for seq_group in sampling_metadata.seq_groups:
   207	        seq_ids = seq_group.seq_ids
   208	        sampling_params = seq_group.sampling_params
   209	
   210	        sample_indices = seq_group.sample_indices
   211	        logits_applied += len(sample_indices) + len(
   212	            seq_group.prompt_logprob_indices)
   213	        if not seq_group.do_sample:
   214	            continue
   215	
   216	        start_idx = sample_indices[0]
   217	        min_tokens = sampling_params.min_tokens
   218	        token_ids_to_penalize = sampling_params.all_stop_token_ids
   219	        if min_tokens > 0 and token_ids_to_penalize:
   220	            seqs_to_penalize: List[int] = []
   221	            for j, seq_id in enumerate(seq_ids):
   222	                seq_data = seq_group.seq_data[seq_id]
   223	                if len(seq_data.output_token_ids) < min_tokens:
   224	                    seqs_to_penalize.append(j)
   225	
   226	            if seqs_to_penalize:
   227	                # convert to the index into logits
   228	                seqs_to_penalize = [start_idx + j for j in seqs_to_penalize]
   229	                # itertools.product pairs each seq index with every token id
   230	                logits_to_penalize.extend(
   231	                    itertools.product(seqs_to_penalize, token_ids_to_penalize))
   232	
   233	    if logits_to_penalize:
   234	        # use zip and * to group indices along each dimension
   235	        # eg. [ (1,2), (1,3), (5,6) ] -> ( (1,1,5), (2,3,6) )
   236	        logits[tuple(zip(*logits_to_penalize))] = -float("inf")
   237	
   238	    # verifies that no rows in logits were missed unexpectedly
   239	    assert logits_applied == logits.shape[0]
   240	    return logits

   243	def _apply_penalties(logits: torch.Tensor, prompt_tokens_tensor: torch.Tensor,
   244	                     output_tokens_tensor: torch.Tensor,
   245	                     presence_penalties: torch.Tensor,
   246	                     frequency_penalties: torch.Tensor,
   247	                     repetition_penalties: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   248	    num_seqs, vocab_size = logits.shape
   249	    _, prompt_mask = _get_bin_counts_and_mask(prompt_tokens_tensor, vocab_size,
   250	                                              num_seqs)
   251	    output_bin_counts, output_mask = _get_bin_counts_and_mask(
   252	        output_tokens_tensor, vocab_size, num_seqs)
   253	
   254	    repetition_penalties = repetition_penalties[:, None].repeat(1, vocab_size)
   255	    repetition_penalties[~(prompt_mask | output_mask)] = 1.0
   256	    logits = torch.where(logits > 0, logits / repetition_penalties,
   257	                         logits * repetition_penalties)
   258	
   259	    # We follow the definition in OpenAI API.
   260	    # Refer to https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/parameter-details
   261	    logits -= frequency_penalties.unsqueeze_(dim=1) * output_bin_counts
   262	    logits -= presence_penalties.unsqueeze_(dim=1) * output_mask
   263	    return logits

   266	def _apply_top_k_top_p(
   267	    logits: torch.Tensor,
   268	    p: torch.Tensor,
   269	    k: torch.Tensor,
   270	) -> torch.Tensor:
   271	    logits_sort, logits_idx = logits.sort(dim=-1, descending=False)
   272	
   273	    # Apply top-k.
   274	    top_k_mask = logits_sort.size(1) - k.to(torch.long)
   275	    # Get all the top_k values.
   276	    top_k_mask = logits_sort.gather(1, top_k_mask.unsqueeze(dim=1))
   277	    top_k_mask = logits_sort < top_k_mask
   278	    logits_sort.masked_fill_(top_k_mask, -float("inf"))
   279	
   280	    # Apply top-p.
   281	    probs_sort = logits_sort.softmax(dim=-1)
   282	    probs_sum = probs_sort.cumsum(dim=-1)
   283	    top_p_mask = probs_sum <= 1 - p.unsqueeze(dim=1)
   284	    # at least one
   285	    top_p_mask[:, -1] = False
   286	    logits_sort.masked_fill_(top_p_mask, -float("inf"))
   287	
   288	    # Re-sort the probabilities.
   289	    src = torch.arange(logits_idx.shape[-1],
   290	                       device=logits_idx.device).expand_as(logits_idx)
   291	    logits_idx_inv = torch.empty_like(logits_idx).scatter_(dim=-1,
   292	                                                           index=logits_idx,
   293	                                                           src=src)
   294	    logits = torch.gather(logits_sort, dim=-1, index=logits_idx_inv)
   295	    return logits

   298	def _apply_min_p(
   299	    logits: torch.Tensor,
   300	    min_p: torch.Tensor,
   301	) -> torch.Tensor:
   302	    """
   303	    Adapted from
   304	    https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui/blob/3146124ec01f02c8fb1650a6517cf1b60b537aaf/modules/sampler_hijack.py#L16C17-L16C17
   305	    """
   306	    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
   307	    top_probs, _ = probs.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
   308	    scaled_min_p = min_p.unsqueeze_(dim=1) * top_probs
   309	    tokens_to_remove = probs < scaled_min_p
   310	    logits = logits.masked_fill_(tokens_to_remove, -float("inf"))
   311	
   312	    return logits

   315	def _greedy_sample(
   316	    selected_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroupToSample],
   317	    samples: torch.Tensor,
   318	) -> SampleResultType:
   319	    """Run greedy sampling on a given samples.
   320	
   321	    Args:
   322	        selected_seq_groups: A list of sequence groups batched.
   323	        samples: (num_selected_samples,) A tensor of samples. The length of
   324	            samples could be smaller than selected_seq_groups if
   325	            seq_group.do_sample is False.
   326	    Returns:
   327	        Tuple of (next_token_ids, parent_ids). The length of returned list is
   328	        same as the length of selected_seq_groups. If the corresponding
   329	        seq_group has do_sample=False, tuple contains ([], [])
   330	    """
   331	    samples_lst = samples.tolist()
   332	    sample_idx = 0
   333	    results: SampleResultType = []
   334	    for seq_group in selected_seq_groups:
   335	        if not seq_group.do_sample:
   336	            results.append(([], []))
   337	            continue
   338	
   339	        seq_ids = seq_group.seq_ids
   340	        num_parent_seqs = len(seq_ids)
   341	        assert num_parent_seqs == 1, (
   342	            "Greedy sampling should have only one seq.")
   343	        parent_ids = list(range(num_parent_seqs))
   344	        next_token_ids = [samples_lst[sample_idx]]
   345	        results.append((next_token_ids, parent_ids))
   346	        sample_idx += num_parent_seqs
   347	    return results

   350	def _random_sample(
   351	    selected_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroupToSample],
   352	    random_samples: torch.Tensor,
   353	) -> SampleResultType:
   354	    """Run random sampling on a given samples.
   355	
   356	    Args:
   357	        selected_seq_groups: A list of sequence groups batched.
   358	        random_samples: (num_selected_samples,) A tensor of samples. The
   359	            length of samples could be smaller than selected_seq_groups if
   360	            seq_group.do_sample is False.
   361	    Returns:
   362	        Tuple of (next_token_ids, parent_ids). The length of returned list is
   363	        same as the length of selected_seq_groups. If the corresponding
   364	        seq_group has do_sample=False, tuple contains ([], [])
   365	    """
   366	    # Find the maximum best_of value of the prompt phase requests.
   367	    random_samples = random_samples.cpu()
   368	    sample_idx = 0
   369	    results: SampleResultType = []
   370	    for seq_group in selected_seq_groups:
   371	        if not seq_group.do_sample:
   372	            results.append(([], []))
   373	            continue
   374	
   375	        seq_ids = seq_group.seq_ids
   376	        sampling_params = seq_group.sampling_params
   377	        is_prompt = seq_group.is_prompt
   378	        num_parent_seqs = len(seq_ids)
   379	        if is_prompt:
   380	            # Prompt phase.
   381	            parent_ids = [0] * sampling_params.best_of
   382	            next_token_ids = random_samples[
   383	                sample_idx, :sampling_params.best_of].tolist()
   384	        else:
   385	            # Generation phase.
   386	            parent_ids = list(range(num_parent_seqs))
   387	            next_token_ids = random_samples[sample_idx:sample_idx +
   388	                                            num_parent_seqs, 0].tolist()
   389	        results.append((next_token_ids, parent_ids))
   390	        sample_idx += num_parent_seqs
   391	    return results
